14917-the-wings-of-the-morning.title: The Wings Of The Morning
14917-the-wings-of-the-morning.creator: Louis Tracy
14917-the-wings-of-the-morning.description: A book by Louis Tracy. Some one told me this morning. I couldn't have guessed it, could I?" Miss Iris Deane's large blue eyes surveyed him with innocent indifference to strict accuracy. Incidentally, she had obtained the information from her maid, a nose-tilted coquette who extracted ship's secrets from a youthful quartermaster.

arxiv-2404-03245.creator: Sunita Jain, Nagaradhesh Yeleswarapu, Hasan Al Maruf, Rita Gupta

arxiv-2407-13962.title: Beam Stacking Experiment at a Fixed Field Alternating Gradient Accelerator
arxiv-2407-13962.creator: T. Uesugi, Y. Ishi, Y. Kuriyama, Y. Mori, C. Jolly, D. J. Kelliher, J. -B. Lagrange, A. P. Letchford, S. Machida, D. W. Posthuma de Boer, C. T. Rogers, E. Yamakawa, M. Topp-Mugglestone
arxiv-2407-13962.description: Abstract A key challenge in particle accelerators is to achieve high peak intensity. Space charge is particularly strong at lower energy such as during injection and typically limits achievable peak intensity. The beam stacking technique can overcome this limitation by accumulating a beam at high energy where space charge is weaker.

arxiv-2505-02765.title: An Almost Tight Lower Bound for Plurality Consensus with Undecided State Dynamics in the Population Protocol Model
arxiv-2505-02765.creator: Antoine El-Hayek, Robert Elsässer, Stefan Schmid
arxiv-2505-02765.description: Abstract . We revisit the majority problem in the population protocol communication model, as first studied by Angluin et al. (Distributed Computing 2008). We consider a more general version of this problem known as plurality consensus, which has already been studied intensively in the literature.

pmc-10496377.title: Triple therapy for Helicobacter pylori eradication and the risk of hypoglycemia in patients with diabetes: a population-based cohort study
pmc-10496377.creator: Anne Chang, Anna Chang, Wan-Ting Chen, Lung Chan, Chien-Tai Hong, Li-Nien Chien
pmc-10496377.description: The incidence of type 2 diabetes mellitus has risen globally, from 108 million cases in 1980 to 422 million cases in 2014. Although controlling glycemic levels in patients with diabetes is crucial, insulin and sulfonylureas can cause hypoglycemic episodes and even potentially fatal events such as comas, seizures, life-threatening arrhythmias, and myocardial infarctions.

pmc-10716053.title: Insight into the Causal Relationship between Gut Microbiota and Back Pain: A Two Sample Bidirectional Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-10716053.creator: Jingni Hui, Yujing Chen, Chun'e Li, Yifan Gou, Ye Liu, Ruixue Zhou, Meijuan Kang, Chen Liu, Bingyi Wang, Panxing Shi, Shiqiang Cheng, Xuena Yang, Chuyu Pan, Yumeng Jia, Bolun Cheng, Huan Liu, Yan Wen, Feng Zhang
pmc-10716053.description: Observational studies have shown that alterations in gut microbiota composition are associated with low back pain. However, it remains unclear whether the association is causal. To reveal the causal association between gut microbiota and low back pain, a two‐sample bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis is performed. The inverse variance weighted regression (IVW) is performed as the principal MR analysis.

pmc-11394933.title: The red blood cell distribution width to albumin ratio was a potential prognostic biomarker for acute respiratory failure: a retrospective study
pmc-11394933.creator: Qian He, Song Hu, Jun xie, Hui Liu, Chong Li
pmc-11394933.description: BackgroundThe association between red blood cell distribution width (RDW) to albumin ratio (RAR) and prognosis in patients with acute respiratory failure (ARF) admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) remains unclear. This retrospective cohort study aims to investigate this association.MethodsClinical information of ARF patients was collected from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) version 2.0 database.

pmc-11414150.title: SPLHRNMTF: robust orthogonal non-negative matrix tri-factorization with self-paced learning and dual hypergraph regularization for predicting miRNA-disease associations
pmc-11414150.creator: Dong Ouyang, Rui Miao, Juan Zeng, Xing Li, Ning Ai, Panke Wang, Jie Hou, Jinqiu Zheng
pmc-11414150.description: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) have been demonstrated to be closely related to human diseases. Studying the potential associations between miRNAs and diseases contributes to our understanding of disease pathogenic mechanisms. As traditional biological experiments are costly and time-consuming, computational models can be considered as effective complementary tools.

pmc-12581404.title: Expression profile of cystatin gene family in alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.) related to biotic and abiotic stress response
pmc-12581404.creator: Jierui Wu, Qian Ai, Rui Dai, Chengmei Zhou, Zhiqiang Zhang, Lan Yun
pmc-12581404.description: BackgroundCystatins are cysteine protease inhibitor in plant and animal that not only regulates the intracellular transport of endogenous proteins in plants but also plays an important role in plant defense against biotic and abiotic stresses. However, the cystatin gene family in alfalfa remains poorly characterized.ResultIn this study, 55 cystatin genes distributed across 18 chromosomes in alfalfa were identified.

pmc-13028490.creator: Edwin D. Lephart, Zoe D. Draelos
pmc-13028490.description: While skin aging is inevitable, healthy habits, sun protection, skincare, and medical interventions can slow visible skin changes; estrogen is also crucial. In 2002, the Women’s Health Initiative (WHI) results contributed to the subsequent trend toward fear and avoidance of hormone replacement therapy (HRT).

pmc-13071131.title: Adverse Hemodynamics in Kommerell's Diverticulum: A Comparative Case Report Linking Oscillatory Shear Index to Aortic Dissection
pmc-13071131.creator: Kenji Sakakibara, Hiroyuki Nakajima, Yukiyo Yoshida, Yudai Hagihara, Chie Nakamura, Soshi Yamamoto, Daichi Shikata, Yuki Takesue, Satoru Shiraiwa, Yoshihiro Honda, Shigeaki Kaga, Masahiro Hamasaki, Hisashi Johno, Yu Sasaki, Hiroaki Watanabe
pmc-13071131.description: Hemodynamic evaluation using four‐dimensional flow magnetic resonance imaging or computational fluid dynamics can identify a high‐risk phenotype in Kommerell's diverticulum, which is characterized by intradiverticular vortex formation, low wall shear stress, and elevated oscillatory shear index (OSI). This functional assessment provides crucial risk stratification beyond anatomical size, as a high OSI may pinpoint intimal vulnerability sites and potential dissection entry.

pmc-13179381.title: Compact dual-band four-port MIMO patch antenna with inverse U-shaped resonators and defected ground structure for wireless communication applications
pmc-13179381.creator: Ketavath Kumar Naik, Chirukuri Naga Phaneendra, Mohammad S. Zidan, Z. Zakaria, A. J. A. Al-Gburi
pmc-13179381.description: A compact four-port multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) staircase rectangular patch antenna with inverse U-shaped resonators and a modified defected ground structure (MDGS) is presented for dual-band wireless communication applications. The antenna integrates four identical radiating elements placed orthogonally to achieve low mutual coupling and enhanced diversity. Fabricated on an FR-4 substrate with dimensions of 38 × 38 × 1.

pmc-13307922.title: Cyclopiazonic Acid Induces Mitochondrial Oxidative Stress in SH-SY5Y Cells: Protective Effects of Extra Virgin Olive Oil Phenolics
pmc-13307922.creator: Carmen Martínez-Alonso, Yelko Rodríguez-Carrasco, María-José Ruiz
pmc-13307922.description: Cyclopiazonic acid (CPA), a neurotoxin produced by Penicillium and Aspergillus genera, induces oxidative stress and neuronal damage, mechanisms implicated in neurodegenerative diseases. This study investigates the oxidative stress induced by CPA in SH-SY5Y human neuroblastoma cells, focusing on mitochondrial membrane potential, mitochondrial superoxide levels, ROS production, lipid peroxidation and gene expression.

pmc-13326466.title: Association of active and passive smoking with adolescent asthma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13326466.creator: Wenwen Shi, Supapon Kaewsanmung, Wuttipat Kiratipaisarl, Ratana Sapbamrer
pmc-13326466.description: ObjectiveTo synthesize evidence on the association of active or passive smoking with asthma in adolescents. Data SourcesA comprehensive search of Embase, PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were conducted from inception to January 2026. Only human studies published in English were included.Study SelectionObservational studies evaluating active or passive smoking in adolescents aged 10–19 years were eligible.

pmc-13469695.title: Strengthening Antimicrobial Stewardship in Nigeria: Qualitative and Quantitative Insights into Barriers, Enablers, and Implementation Strategies (2015–2025)
pmc-13469695.creator: Omobolanle Margaret Abe, Rasha Abdelsalam Elshenawy
pmc-13469695.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance is a critical global health threat. Nigeria faces particular challenges implementing antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) programs due to structural barriers and resource constraints. This review synthesizes evidence on barriers, facilitators, and strategies influencing AMS implementation in Nigerian healthcare facilities.

pmc-13711198.title: Evaluating preoperative imaging in patients with chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension: Is computed tomography pulmonary angiography a reliable alternative to pulmonary angiography?
pmc-13711198.creator: Rawan Alamri, Hamnah Majeed, Fayeza Ahmad, Ziyab Sarfaraz, Andrew Hirsch, Jean-François Morin
pmc-13711198.description: ObjectivesChronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension is a potentially curable form of pulmonary hypertension, with pulmonary endarterectomy serving as a key surgical treatment option. Accurate preoperative imaging is critical for determining surgical candidacy and optimizing operative outcomes. Although digital subtraction pulmonary angiography remains the gold standard, computed tomography pulmonary angiography has emerged as a noninvasive alternative.
